# Ironsworn Oracles

Every rollable table this adapter ships, by collection; a table's file also carries
its summary. Paths are relative to this adapter, so `oracles/<path>` rolls as `roll table ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/adapters/ironsworn/oracles/<path>`.

## Oracle collections

### Action and Theme Oracles

- `oracles/action.md` — Action
- `oracles/theme.md` — Theme

### Character

- `oracles/character/role.md` — Character Role
- `oracles/character/goal.md` — Character Goal
- `oracles/character/descriptor.md` — Character Descriptor

### Name

- `oracles/name/elf.md` — Elf Names

#### Ironlander Names

Use this oracle to quickly generate a name for an Ironlander character. Roll on either table. Surnames are not used in the Ironlands, and names are often gender-neutral.

- `oracles/name/ironlander/a.md` — Table A
- `oracles/name/ironlander/b.md` — Table B

#### Other Names

Use this oracle to generate names for other firstborn characters.

- `oracles/name/other/giants.md` — Giants
- `oracles/name/other/varou.md` — Varou
- `oracles/name/other/trolls.md` — Trolls

- `oracles/place/region.md` — Region
- `oracles/place/location.md` — Location
- `oracles/place/coastal-waters-location.md` — Coastal Waters Location
- `oracles/place/descriptor.md` — Location Descriptor

### Settlement Oracles

To give the settlement additional detail, roll on the Location Descriptor (`oracles/place/descriptor.md`) oracle. To spark an idea for an event or feature related to the settlement, roll on the Action (`oracles/action.md`) and Theme (`oracles/theme.md`) oracles.

- `oracles/settlement/trouble.md` — Settlement Trouble
- `oracles/settlement/name.md` — Settlement Name

#### Settlement Name

- `oracles/settlement/name/landscape-feature.md` — Landscape Feature

- `oracles/settlement/name/environmental-aspect.md` — Environmental Aspect
- `oracles/settlement/name/something-else.md` — Something Else

#### Quick Settlement Name Generator

Use this oracle as a simpler alternative for settlement names. Roll once for the prefix, and once for the suffix. If the combination doesn’t quite work, look at adjacent rows or reverse the digits.

- `oracles/settlement/quick-name/prefix.md` — Prefix
- `oracles/settlement/quick-name/suffix.md` — Suffix
